how.text:
Every visit shows 1 of the 3 demos in the hero, picked at random. "Try another" cycles them. The Lab opens on the next one, so a visitor never sees the same demo twice in a row.

Press Play on the homepage and try the theme switch (Auto / Light / Dark) in the top bar.

motion.text: Motion rule: every animation shows a real state change or data flow. Page load: the name wipes in line by line, then the 3 status lamps switch on, then the demo slides in. Request dots travel the track; the flow lines move in the direction data moves. Reduced motion turns all of it off.
